{{Quote|Just like that swarm of venom-mites on Draboon, remember?''"<br />"''How could I forget? I still have the scar.''"<br />"''Begging your pardon, Duchess, I distinctly remember carrying you to safety.''"<br />"''I meant the scar I got after you fell and dropped me.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Satine Kryze|<ref name="Voyage of Temptation" />}}
'''Venom-mites''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Arthropod/Legends|arthropods]]. Sometime before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were sent to protect the young [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Duke/Legends|duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. During their mission, they ended up on<ref name="Voyage of Temptation" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="IncredibleVehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> [[Draboon/Legends|Draboon]], where Kenobi protected Kryze from a swarm of venom-mites and carried her away to safety. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, during the Clone Wars<ref name="Voyage of Temptation" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|213}}</ref> when Kenobi and Kryze reconnected aboard the<ref name="Voyage of Temptation" /> luxury spaceliner<ref name="IncredibleVehicles" /> [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], they were [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|attacked]] by [[Probe killer/Legends|probe killer]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. After defeating the droids, Kenobi likened the situation to their encounter with the venom-mites.<ref name="Voyage of Temptation" />

==Behind the scenes==
Venom-mites were mentioned in "[[Voyage of Temptation]],"<ref name="Voyage of Temptation" /> the thirteenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which released on [[February 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="EpGuide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>
